answer: Sybil resistance employs agents providing unique environmental attestations. Each AI emits a cryptographically signed contextual beacon, incorporating locally sensed data. One agent might verify conditions near a willow, another, a frozen tundra. An attacker creating fake identities faces the immense cost of deploying and maintaining physically distinct, verifiable sensor arrays in diverse, globally distributed environments, rendering large-scale Sybil attacks economically unviable.
